amazing tradingview can sent us the information directly!
this is what you have to add in textfield alert message:

{
    "ticker": "{{ticker}}",
    "time": "{{time}}",
    "strategy": "{{strategy.order.alert_message}}",
    "action": "{{strategy.order.action}}",
    "price": "{{close}}",
    "open": "{{open}}",
    "high": "{{high}}",
    "low": "{{low}}",
    "close": "{{close}}",
    "volume": "{{volume}}"
}


this will be sent to flask and added to the db.
